$comment: Own project, NOT referenced by the root tsconfig.json — the editor must start when `npm run build` is broken, because a broken brain is exactly when you need it (the gateway's arrangement, docs/decisions/0002). Run it with `npm run typecheck:brain-editor`. Imports carry their real `.ts` extension and the syntax stays erasable, so tests/features/brain-editor.test.ts can import these files under `node --test`'s type stripping, as tests/tsconfig.json explains.
